How well did the responses address the course content related to this question? How well did the 
responses integrate the skills required on this question? 

Part (a) 

• 
Almost all responses recognized the need to use the derivatives of the given functions to find the acceleration of 
the particle. 

• 
Quite frequently responses correctly identified the acceleration vector as

Part (b)  

• 
Nearly all responses presented a correct equation that could be solved in order to find the requested time. 

• 
Responses indicated that most students knew how to use their calculator to solve an equation. 

• 
Almost all responses that found more than one of the times when the particle’s speed was 1.5 correctly 
committed to the first time.
